format: mono 48000 Hz Opus, 128 kbps VBR; zero header gain
rights: Owner explicitly confirmed publication clearance for the selected edited Urban Explosions clips and mixed before/after captures in the #112 implementation session. Original masters remain private. Retain applicable entitlement/licence records; media do not inherit the code licence.
design: Four distinct bursts per bank from BOOM Urban Explosions Designed. Small neutral/crisp grenade versus large urban/crisp bomb, each with recorded close/mid/far perspectives. Source labels are design character, not verified M67 or aerial-bomb field recordings. Mono average, 25 Hz high-pass and 14 kHz low-pass; trim to 5 ms before the first 5 ms RMS block reaching 20% of the first-second maximum, retain decays, 1 ms entrance and 100 ms exit fades. Match the first 350 ms RMS across perspectives, subject to -2.5 dBFS sample-peak headroom. No pitch shifting, synthesis, compression or limiting. Runtime owns propagation, attenuation, occlusion and a restrained local reverb send.
